neighbours.label: parts that transmit rotation in a drive train (pulley, sprocket, gear wheel, flywheel, chainring teeth), as against other machine parts and other senses of the same words
fire: In the workshop, the lathe was driven by a flat belt looped over a cast-iron pulley.
For the new bike he chose a smaller rear sprocket to climb hills more easily.
Through the glass case you can see each brass gear wheel turning the hands.
The well used a rope over a wooden pulley so one person could lift the bucket.
When the chain jumped off the front sprocket, she had to stop on the trail.
A heavy flywheel keeps the old steam engine turning between strokes.
Teeth on the large gear wheel mesh with a smaller pinion on the motor shaft.
At the top of the lift tower, the cable passes around a huge steel pulley.
quiet: In the workshop, the lathe was bolted to a heavy oak bench near the window.
For the new bike he chose a wider saddle to ride longer distances comfortably.
Through the glass case you can see the enamel dial and the painted numbers.
The well used a wooden lid so leaves would not fall into the water.
When the brake cable snapped, she had to stop on the trail.
A heavy piston slides inside each cylinder of the old steam engine.
Bolts on the large steel frame hold the motor in place on the floor.
At the top of the lift tower, a small cabin houses the operator in winter.
